name: Best Source Electronic Corporation.
old_description: Best Source Electronics Corporation (BSEC) is more than just a cable assembly/wire harness manufacturer; we exist to serve, exceed expectations and develop relationships with our customers, vendors and employees. Driven to excel, our ambition is to exceed expectations and earn your trust and confidence, which results in a long-term, two-way partnership.
about:
Best Source Electronics Corporation (BSEC) was founded in 1997 in Blaine, Minnesota. The company began as a cable assembly and wire harness manufacturer and has since expanded its offerings to include a range of custom electronic manufacturing services.

BSEC produces cable assemblies, wire harnesses, custom interconnect solutions, custom lighting solutions, custom cooling solutions, and complete box builds. The company emphasizes its ability to handle complex, previously considered impossible projects and offers expedited order fulfillment when needed.

The company serves a diverse set of industries, including air traffic control and satellite systems, agricultural equipment, test and measurement, packaging, appliance manufacturing, medical devices, and military and defense. Its products have been deployed in environments ranging from the ocean floor to outer space.

BSEC differentiates itself through a culture of "extra effort," guided by core values of integrity, growth, ingenuity, compassion, and drive. The company states that solving problems no one else could figure out excites them, and they aim to build long-term, two-way partnerships with customers, vendors, and employees.
